World Sportbike Championship Dates 👌🏼

Put them in your calendar 📆

Excited for @fentonseabright47 & @harrison_dessoy55 to take on the world Sportbike championship as the officially supported @officialtriumphracing team on the Daytona 660 👌🏼🔥

#sportbike #triumph #WorldSPB #phrperformance #WSBK

This year marked my second year attending the Bike Shed Dinner with the Plan B Group with Triumph East London, and once again, it did not disappoint! Some great laughs, great food, and a fantastic end to the evening with a raffle, giving away some brilliant Triumph suitcases, merchandise, and motorcycle cleaning supplies. Along with some of my own prizes, too! Standout moment for me was most definitely picking the winners for the raffle, lots of lucky prize winners, and it was terrific to see happy faces at the end of the evening!

The raffle at the end of the night was opened by a fantastic band playing some absolute classics. I am glad to say there were lots of winners on the night, and it was great to see everyone enjoy it. Definitely looking forward to hitting back with some more events in 2026 with the Triumph East London Crew.

I’ve been very grateful to be invited to take part for a second year — whether contributing racing memorabilia to raffles or helping support a fantastic event— it’s been great to see first-hand how supportive and inclusive the Plan B Group really is.

I must give an enormous shoutout to all the friends and guests on the night who made some fabulous donations to the raffle, which are very kindly being put towards my racing funds for the 2026 race season.

Participation in the raffle contributes enormously to having the funds available to be on the World Sportbike Grid this year and to knowing that I have been able to prepare in the best way possible during the winter period to compete with some of the world's fastest riders.

I'm massively looking forward to getting more practice time on my Triumph Daytona 660 over the next few months before my first round of the season, from the 27th to the 29th of March, at the Portimao Circuit. With Physical training gaining momentum, I feel I’m building momentum for the season opener.

A final big and significant shoutout to Marc Jordan, who is the manager of the LIND Triumph East London shop in Romford, who leads and organises these events.
